title: Pay for Hints, Not Answers: LLM Shepherding for Cost-Efficient Inference
rejection_reason: Controls hint length in SLM/LLM collaboration rather than admission or tenant budget settlement.

title: LLM Bandit: Cost-Efficient LLM Generation via Preference-Conditioned Dynamic Routing
rejection_reason: Preprint superseded for this review by stronger peer-reviewed contextual-bandit routing evidence.

title: Duo-LLM: A Framework for Studying Adaptive Computation in Large Language Models
rejection_reason: Token/layer routing inside a model; outside request-level provider routing.

title: Beyond Per-Token Pricing: A Concurrency-Aware Methodology for LLM Infrastructure Cost Estimation
rejection_reason: Concurrency-aware self-hosted unit economics; no API token-liability ledger.

title: X-Router: Decoupling Knowledge and Reasoning for Cost-Effective LLM Inference
rejection_reason: Routes retrieval and reasoning choices, not delayed cost settlement.

title: LongWriter: Unleashing 10,000+ Word Generation from Long Context LLMs
rejection_reason: Useful output-tail context but not an admission-control method.

title: CR2: Cost-Aware Risk-Controlled Routing for Wireless Device-Edge LLM Inference
rejection_reason: Risk is correctness at the device-edge boundary; accepted RACER is a stronger comparator for routing-risk precedent.

title: Conformal Thinking: Risk Control for Reasoning on a Compute Budget
rejection_reason: Inference-time reasoning stopping rather than cross-model monetary admission; its risk-control dimension is already represented.

title: RouteNLP: Closed-Loop LLM Routing with Conformal Cascading and Distillation Co-Optimization
rejection_reason: Recent preprint overlaps accepted routing and conformal comparators without adding liability settlement.

title: CP-Router: An Uncertainty-Aware Router Between LLM and LRM
rejection_reason: Correctness routing already covered more directly by RACER for the novelty decision.

title: ZEBRA: Zero-shot Budgeted Resource Allocation for LLM Orchestration
rejection_reason: Allocates a fixed multi-phase budget for utility; does not reserve uncertain provider liabilities.

title: Budgeted Act-or-Defer Multi-Agent LLM Deliberation with Local Reliability Bounds
rejection_reason: Controls wrong-action reliability budget rather than monetary cost settlement.

title: COST-GOV: An Operational Decision Framework for Governance-Aware LLM Routing in Enterprises
rejection_reason: Scenario-evaluated design-science framework; no empirical reserve-settle or concurrent-liability evaluation.

title: Multi-LLM Prototype: Open-source software for adaptive orchestration, conflict resolution, and cost-aware routing across heterogeneous large language models
rejection_reason: September 2026 issue date is after the 13 July 2026 review cutoff.

title: Pricing Online LLM Services with Data-Calibrated Stackelberg Routing Game
rejection_reason: PriLLM optimizes dynamic service pricing rather than admission under unresolved token-cost liability.

title: LLM Routing with Dueling Feedback
rejection_reason: Relevant partial-feedback context but does not materially extend retained observational and bandit routing comparators.

title: Routing, Cascades, and User Choice for LLMs
rejection_reason: Provider/user incentives and latency rather than hard budget accounting.

title: FINOS AI Governance Framework
rejection_reason: Governance guidance rather than a routing or settlement research method.

title: Token-Budget-Aware Pool Routing for Cost-Efficient LLM Inference
rejection_reason: Withdrawn duplicate of retained arXiv:2604.08075; the current record has no PDF or license.
